text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xxs and node flaps observed in inference-pool-usw-2. Alert rule: inference.pool.node_unstable > 3 nodes in NotReady within 5m. Link: https://ops.redwood.local/incidents/2698765432

oncall_liz: acked, I'm oncall. Paging SRE.

eng_runtime_mike: seeing kubelet restart loops on a few GPU nodes. stack traces show `kubelet: runtime: out of memory` followed by `docker: containerd: CRI: OOMKilled`. Also intermittent `nvidia-smi` timeouts in the node logs.

infra_tess: on it — checking node boot logs and driver versions. Could be recent driver rollout (tag: gpu-driver:v2026-02).

sre_jordan: quick triage: are these nodes flapping NotReady or NetworkNotReady? any kernel panics?

eng_runtime_mike: NotReady after kubelet restart; dmesg includes repeated `NVRM: Xid` CUDA errors. Example from node-uw2-gpu-07:

```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568001] Killed process 2345 (runserver) total-vm:123456kB, anon-rss:98765kB
[ 1234.568010] oom-killer: killing process 2345 (runserver) score 987
```

eng_runtime_mike: container logs show `OOMKilled` for model-server, restart loops then kubelet restarts.

oncall_liz: customer impact? any 5xx spikes tied to model versions?

ps_tyler: CS: multiple customers (customer-a, customer-b) reporting elevated latency and intermittent 502/504s in US-W region. Working on messaging but need ETA.

eng_runtime_mike: mitigation plan: 1) cordon problematic nodes; 2) drain pods to healthy nodes in pool or to failover pool (inference-pool-usw-1); 3) scale up replacement nodes with older driver image (gpu-driver:v2026-01); 4) toggle routing to reduce traffic to usw-2.

sre_jordan: runbook steps we ran:
```
# cordon and drain
kubectl cordon node-uw2-gpu-07
kubectl drain node-uw2-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force

# scale replacement
kctl autoscaler set replicas inference-pool-usw-2 10

# patch DaemonSet to use fallback driver image
kubectl set image ds/nvidia-driver nvidia-driver=registry.redwood.local/gpu-driver:v2026-01 -n infra
```

deployment-bot: Deploy started: rollback gpu-driver rollout from v2026-02 -> v2026-01. CI link: https://ci.redwood.local/rollouts/7432

infra_tess: I'm seeing a spike in kernel oops tied to `nv_peer_mem` module on the newer driver. Reverting driver on a subset of nodes now.

oncall_liz: I'm steering traffic off inference-pool-usw-2 via global router for ~30% of traffic, prioritizing high-SLA customers to other pools.

ps_tyler: started targeted CS outreach to highest-impact accounts; requested status page update.

eng_runtime_mike: temporary autoscaling set to add 4 warm nodes in usw-1 and eu-west to absorb load. Also enabling aggressive prefix cache in router to reduce token regen.

sre_jordan: monitoring: added a short-lived synthetic check hitting a health endpoint every 10s across pools.

infra_tess: driver rollback to v2026-01 completed on 5 nodes, they came back Ready. Two nodes still flapping — investigating hardware-level trace for GPU resets.

eng_runtime_mike: logs from kubelet on node-uw2-gpu-09 show `process kubelet[PID]: runtime error: GPU reset during inference` then `systemd: kubelet.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE`

oncall_liz: handoff to infra_tess and eng_runtime_mike for remediation. I'll remain on the thread for coordination and customer updates.

ps_tyler: status page: "Partial degradation in US-W inference — some requests may see 5xx/latency. We're mitigating; next update in 15m."

eng_runtime_mike: temporary mitigations implemented: driver rollback, cordon/drain, scaled replacements, routing shift. Early metrics: 5xx rate dropped ~60% in 10m, p95 latency for generation down from 2.4s to 1.1s for rerouted traffic.

sre_jordan: still seeing kubelet restarts on 2 nodes; plan: reboot nodes, collect kdump if available, and isolate NIC/GPU PCI resets.

infra_tess: requesting approval for rolling reboot across remaining flappers and kernel module reloads.

oncall_liz: approved. Proceed, keep me posted.

eng_runtime_mike: collecting logs and will open postmortem ticket. Notes to include: driver rollout correlation, GPU Xid codes, OOM kills of model-server, scaling/traffic shifts, customer impact list.

ps_tyler: CS update posted and customers notified. No escalations to legal/security.

deployment-bot: Rollback completed: 5 nodes updated, 3 nodes pending manual reboot.

sre_jordan: walked through checklist, will keep thread open until last node stable. Assigning postmortem owner: @eng_runtime_mike.

oncall_liz: Thanks team — leaving oncall for the shift rotation in 45m, handoff done to infra_tess/SRE. :thumbsup:

infra_tess: manual reboots completed on pending nodes; all nodes reporting Ready. Continued monitoring for 30m.

eng_runtime_mike: creating postmortem in PM tracker: PM-2026-0821. Will include timelines, mitigation steps, and recommendations: stricter driver rollout gating, early Xid alerting, and automated fallback routing.

ps_tyler: final customer note queued for 2h post-incident with RCA summary.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation succeeded; recovery window started at 2698765900. Follow-up: postmortem assigned. :white_check_mark:"
